learning_objective: 🎯 We will become smart brain detectives and solve amazing number and shape puzzles!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sometimes numbers hide inside a magic grid or box. We have to carefully add or subtract to find the secret missing number!
We can join small triangles and squares together to make a big beautiful fish or a house. This is called a shape puzzle!
Playing with puzzles makes our brains very strong and sharp. It is like a super fun playground for our minds!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Matchstick Magic
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents for some small sticks or matchsticks. Try to build a house or a shiny star shape by joining them on a table!

quick_recap: ⭐ Puzzles are fun games that help us think clearly and deeply.
⭐ We can solve number puzzles by finding patterns and rules.
⭐ Shape puzzles let us build new things by mixing older shapes.
